72.requirement: Определить суммы без float, валюты, состояния и журнал переходов; provider-specific состояния сохраняются и не теряются при нормализации.
observations: Exact integer minor units and explicit currency/exponent; floats and implicit rounding refused.
Immutable full order binding, invoice/payment/refund states and transactional audit.
Native provider state and rejected authenticated observations survive reopen; no normalization loss.

limits: Local Windows with fresh core/SDK/TypeScript/Chrome consumers; all components remain experimental.
This accepts a monetary data model, not live provider operation, real devices or production release.
Other roadmap requirements retain their existing status until separately proved and committed.
